result.summary: The street features a wide, unmarked roadway with sidewalks on both sides, though the left walkway is bordered by a tall chain-link fence. There is a lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure, lane markings, or traffic calming measures, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross the wide street without designated protection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: A large patch/pothole in the center of the road could cause vehicles to swerve unexpectedly.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The street features a continuous concrete sidewalk but lacks any physical buffer or street trees to separate pedestrians from the roadway. The presence of large blank building walls and a lack of traffic calming measures creates a functional but uninviting pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians are separated from moving traffic only by a narrow curb, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The large windowless wall on the left reduces natural surveillance and creates a less secure feeling for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk degradation
hazards.description: Weeds and cracks in the pavement could present minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible in the foreground sidewalk slabs

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting street trees along the curb would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding lower-height lighting would improve visibility and security for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repairing cracks and removing weeds to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides, but they are in poor condition with significant cracking and uneven surfaces. There are no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices visible, creating a potentially hazardous environment for pedestrians despite the presence of mature street trees.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on both sides of the street is heavily cracked and uneven, presenting a significant tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians, forcing them to cross in unmarked areas without protection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and repave the existing sidewalks to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide but poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to a fenced open field. There is a lack of basic safety infrastructure such as street lighting, marked crossings, or traffic calming measures, though mature trees provide significant shade.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked with significant vegetation growth, creating tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground along the walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which may lead to poor visibility and safety concerns at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve nighttime visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If this location serves as a park entrance, install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage.
